source_anchor: Pope et al. 2022 "Efficiently Scaling Transformer Inference" §2.2 (KV cache); vLLM PagedAttention block layout (Kwon et al. 2023)
prompt_text: Ring-buffer KV cache write index: for cache_size=8 and n_writes=23, the write index of the LAST write (0-based) is (n_writes - 1) mod cache_size. Print the integer.

candidate_responses.text: CORRECT: wraps the formula in a ringPos function for reuse — same modular arithmetic.
candidate_responses.code: function ringPos(N, writes){ return (writes - 1) % N; } console.log(ringPos(8, 23));

candidate_responses.text: WRONG: drops the -1 step (counts inclusive-of-current-write into the index slot).
CARGO-CULT: cache_size / n_writes / modulo, but converts to 1-based indexing at the end.
